renderer_priority: torch if alive and not hurt
bat if alive and attacking and not hurt

states.note: Current charge path enters FIRE directly; EQUIP renderer/timer exists but is not entered by this path. Fire held until release/interruption. Damage interval 12 ticks.

simulation_notes: Counters increment at end of simulation; intervals are counter values, not a promise of first rendered dwell.
3-tick hitstop freezes g.ticks, locomotion and attack counters; input/torch preprocessing precedes hitstop.
A target is hit once per punch/bat via hit_mask. Artwork must not change active intervals.
Invulnerability 60 ticks after hit; hurt 12; defeated recovery 120. Respawn gives 120 invulnerability ticks.
Ground bat freezes walking; normal movement 390/256 px/tick, ground punch 100/256, torch 140/256, diagonal factor 181/256.
